description: Expected outcome of every T0 test on the current release branch. It differs from the previous release only where a release declares a progression test: v0.0.1 flipped T0.12 (README truth); v0.0.2 flips T0.6 (dual Kafka listener, P-1) and adds T-REPRO (every pulled image pinned to version+digest, P-3/P-4) as a new, already-passing gate.
